CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   D. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.

   B. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   D. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   B. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)

   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs
